· Each mile driven by a petrol vehicle emits 0.40 kg CO₂

· Each kWh of electricity consumed emits 0.85 kg CO₂

· Each kilogram of waste generated emits 1.20 kg CO₂

· Recycling today (1 = Yes, 0 = No)

· Used public transport today (1 = Yes, 0 = No)

· Waste generated (kg)

Electricity Emission = electricity × 0.85

Waste Emission = waste × 1.20

Total Carbon Footprint = Vehicle Emission + Electricity Emission +Waste Emission

Expected Output

· Vehicle emission

· Electricity emission

· Waste emission

· Total carbon footprint

· Whether the target (<20 kg) is achieved

· Whether the citizen is Eco-Friendly

· Each kilogram of waste generated emits 1.20 kg CO₂

· Recycling today (1 = Yes, 0 = No)

· Used public transport today (1 = Yes, 0 = No)

A person is considered an Eco-Friendly Citizen if:

· Total carbon footprint is less than 20 kg CO₂, AND the person recycled, AND the person used public transport.

· Miles driven

· Electricity consumed (kWh)

· Waste generated (kg)

· Recycled? (1/0)

· Used public transport? (1/0)

Vehicle Emission = miles × 0.40

Electricity Emission = electricity × 0.85

Waste Emission = waste × 1.20

Total Carbon Footprint = Vehicle Emission + Electricity Emission +Waste Emission

Expected Output

· Vehicle emission

· Electricity emission

· Waste emission

· Total carbon footprint

· Whether the target (<20 kg) is achieved

· Whether the citizen is Eco-Friendly
